definitions.explanation: The hands including the fingers, as a written and medical word. Became familiar to everyone on signs reading {手指|しゅし}{消毒|しょうどく} (hand sanitizing) during the COVID-19 pandemic.

examples.japanese: {手指|しゅし}⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧
{入口|いりぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手指|しゅし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please sanitize your hands at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手指|しゅし}⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: There is alcohol sanitizer for hands at the shop entrance.

notes:
Also read てゆび in some texts, but しゅし is standard in {手指|しゅし}⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧. In conversation people say simply ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手指|しゅし}⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧: hand sanitizing
- {手指|しゅし}⟦{衛生|えいせい}→衛生：14049_eisei⟧: hand hygiene
- {手指|しゅし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧: movement of the hands and fingers
